description: This file contains the implementation of a local SQLite database interface for persistence in a Flutter application. It manages tables for downloads, download queue, watch history, and recent searches, providing methods to open the database, perform CRUD operations, and close the database connection.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Handles database operations and persistence related to downloads, watch history, recent searches, and download queue state.

classes.name: WatchHistoryEntry
classes.description: Data class representing an entry in the watch history.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the database, creating necessary tables if they do not exist.

methods.name: upsertWatchProgress
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a watch progress record for a given content ID.

methods.name: getWatchProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved watch position in seconds for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Fetches a list of recent watch history entries ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: upsertRecentSearch
methods.description: Adds or updates a search query in the recent searches list.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent search queries ordered by recency.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all stored recent search queries.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if a download exists for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getDownloadStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the download status for a particular content ID.

methods.name: getDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Checks whether the download queue is paused.

methods.name: setDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the download queue.
